description: An oil painting of a swaddled baby asleep in a dark carved wooden rocking cradle, in a dim room lit by a window at upper left. At left a small black-and-brass globe sits on a stack of old leather-bound books, and the top spine carries legible painted lettering that begins NATURAL. Through the window a grey industrial city shows tall smokestacks, smoke plumes and low houses with lit windows. A plain white margin surrounds the painting on all sides, so it does not fill the image, and a scrawled signature sits in the lower right of the painting.
reason: The painting sits inside a plain white border instead of filling the image edge to edge. Book spines show painted lettering (NATURAL...) and there is a signature in the lower right corner. The scene is a baby in a cradle with books and a globe beside a smoky industrial city, which could loosely suggest creation or a new age but does not clearly show the publication of Frankenstein.
